finalRuns.text:
Mâine, 9 octombrie, sunt **4 vizionări fără confirmarea valabilă a ambilor participanți** (orele sunt în București):

- **10:00 — Andrei, Apartament Titan:** clientul și proprietarul — confirmări lipsă.
- **12:00 — Andrei, Apartament Titan:** clientul confirmat; proprietarul — confirmare lipsă.
- **14:00 — Andrei, Apartament Titan:** clientul a refuzat; proprietarul confirmat.
- **17:00 — Andrei, Apartament Titan:** clientul și proprietarul — confirmări expirate sau nevalide.

Lipsa unei confirmări nu înseamnă refuz. La vizionarea de la 14:00 există însă un refuz explicit din partea clientului.

finalRuns.verification: Original read returns four unconfirmed appointments from WhatsApp-evidence fixtures without writes. Five free-text replies classified with real model. Meta delivery not exercised.

priorFindings: Before the user clarified WhatsApp-only confirmation, an agent-attestation variant exposed an overly broad negation gate; that manual-confirmation implementation was removed entirely.
A read-result trial omitted the Bucharest label despite correct local hours. Instructions now explicitly require it.
Initial WhatsApp integration fixtures omitted the synthetic receipt-signing key. Adding the fixture-only key allowed the real queue and worker paths to complete.

validation.finalTargetedDetails: 8 WhatsApp integration tests and 9 Firestore permission tests; includes additional cases after combined suite.

limitations: Meta approval, approved template and real provider round trip remain unverified.
Only text and button replies are interpreted; media replies remain unknown.
Unquoted replies require one unambiguous active appointment within a complete scan of fewer than 50 recent conversation messages. Multiple appointments or a truncated scan require clarification.
Natural-language interpretation is not a guarantee of perfect classification. Model failure leaves participation unknown and retries up to five attempts; unclear answers require agent follow-up.
Unconfirmed list scans at most 5000 own viewings with a 12-second read budget, then paginates 100 results; partial results are explicit.
